# Issue #5: Document the API endpoints and lending rules

The README covers setup and the lending rules, but there's no reference for
the endpoints. New contributors have to read the route files to find out what
exists. Please add an API section listing each endpoint with its method,
path, purpose and the main error responses, plus a short `curl` example for
checking out and returning a book.

 - A member can hold at most 3 books at once.
 - A member with an overdue loan cannot borrow until it is returned.
 
+## API
+
+Interactive docs (Swagger UI) are served at `/docs` when the app is running.
+All error responses use FastAPI's default shape: `{"detail": "<message>"}`.
+Business-rule violations (see [Lending rules](#lending-rules)) return `409`;
+missing resources return `404`; invalid query parameters return `422`.
+
+### Books
+
+| Method | Path | Purpose | Parameters | Responses |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `GET` | `/books` | List/search the catalog, paginated | Query: `q` (optional, matches title or author), `limit` (1-100, default 20), `offset` (default 0) | `200` `BookPage` (`{"total": int, "items": [Book]}`); `422` if `limit`/`offset` are out of range |
+| `GET` | `/books/{book_id}` | Get one book, including live availability | Path: `book_id` | `200` `Book` fields plus `available` (copies not currently on loan); `404` if the book does not exist |
+
+### Loans
+
+| Method | Path | Purpose | Parameters | Responses |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `POST` | `/loans` | Check out a book to a member | Body: `{"book_id": int, "member_id": int}` | `201` `Loan`; `404` if the book or member does not exist; `409` `"Member has overdue loans"`, `409 "Member already has 3 active loans"`, or `409 "No copies available"` |
+| `POST` | `/loans/{loan_id}/return` | Return a loan and compute any late fee | Path: `loan_id` | `200` `Loan` (with `returned` and `fee_cents` set); `404` if the loan does not exist; `409 "Loan already returned"` |
+| `GET` | `/loans/{loan_id}` | Get one loan | Path: `loan_id` | `200` `Loan`; `404` if the loan does not exist |
+| `GET` | `/members/{member_id}/loans` | List a member's loans, flagged with overdue status | Path: `member_id` | `200` list of `Loan` fields plus `overdue` (bool); `404` if the member does not exist |
+
+A `Loan` looks like:
+
+```json
+{
+  "id": 1,
+  "book_id": 1,
+  "member_id": 1,
+  "checked_out": "2026-03-02",
+  "due": "2026-03-16",
+  "returned": null,
+  "fee_cents": 0
+}
+```
+
+### Example: check out and return a book
+
+```bash
+# Check out book 1 for member 1
+curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/loans \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d '{"book_id": 1, "member_id": 1}'
+# -> 201 {"id": 1, "book_id": 1, "member_id": 1, "checked_out": "...", "due": "...", "returned": null, "fee_cents": 0}
+
+# Return loan 1 (fee_cents is non-zero if returned after "due")
+curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/loans/1/return
+# -> 200 {"id": 1, ..., "returned": "...", "fee_cents": 0}
+```
+
